title.en: Nanyang Polytechnic Students’ Union and Constituent Bodies (Exemption) Order

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Nanyang Polytechnic Students’ Union and Constituent Bodies (Exemption) Order.

2. The Nanyang Polytechnic Students’ Union (referred to in this Order as the Union) and its constituent bodies specified in the Schedule are hereby exempted from the provisions of the Societies Act [Cap. 311], subject to the following conditions:
(a)the Union or a constituent body shall furnish the Registrar of Societies with such information concerning the Union or the constituent body, or such documents, accounts and books relating to the Union or the constituent body as he may require;
(b)the Union or a constituent body shall not use any flag, symbol, emblem, badge or insignia without the consent in writing of the Registrar of Societies; and
(c)the Union or a constituent body shall not be used for any unlawful purpose or for any purpose prejudicial to public peace, welfare or good order in Singapore or for any purpose incompatible with the objects and rules of the Union or the constituent body.

THE SCHEDULE
1.The Business Management Club.
2.The Engineering Club.
3.The Health and Social Science Club.
[S 652/2020 wef 30/07/2020]
4.The Information Technology Club.
5.The Adventure Club.
6.The Community Services Club.
7.The Cultural and Arts Club.
8.The Current Affairs and Debating Club.
9.The Martial Arts Club.
10.The Sports Club.
11.The Water Sports Club.
